# TTD CI gate baseline (PLAN #40 Phase 0, Step 2, requirements BR-7 / BR-8 / BR-9).
# Read by core/tests/debugger/ttd/bench/ttdbench_test.cpp.
# Exported by tools/verification/ttd-bench/ttd_bench_compare.py from a run of
# engine v1, set ci, ttd-engine@612bb2acc, Release, MacStudio.localdomain.
# Deterministic metrics only (bytes, bytes and operations per frame): timings do not
# belong in a stored baseline.
# Columns: <configuration>/<workload> <metric> <value> <tolerance percent>
# Tolerance 0 = exact; heap metrics follow the allocator's growth policy.
# ATM3/idle exact rows updated 2026-09-30 (not-modeled-waits): the EvoTurboCache blob and the 14 MHz waits.
# ATM3/idle blob and file rows updated 2026-10-01 (E8): the EvoFontRam blob (2050 bytes per capture).
# PENTAGON rows updated 2026-10-01 (joystick arm): the KempstonJoystick blob, 14 bytes per capture (2 bytes and the 12-byte header).
# ATM3/idle rows nudged 2026-10-01 (E8b): the clock select now switches at the next M1 refresh, so the idle run differs slightly.
# ATM3/idle blob and file rows updated 2026-10-01 (Kempston joystick): the KempstonJoystick blob (id 23, 14 bytes per capture, 854 over 61); nothing else moved.
# ATM3/idle blob and file rows updated 2026-10-01 (esp-modules): the SerialPort blob (id 24) - the ZX-Evo AVR's UART is always there (~48 compressed bytes per checkpoint).
# All rows 2026-10-01 (ttd-gate-stable): bm2_work_* added - counted capture work, the gate's load-independent check of capture cost; every other row unchanged.
# ATM3/idle blob, RAM and file rows updated 2026-10-02 (mouse-manager M3): the EvoMouse blob (id 38, 20 bytes per capture with its header); the idle ROM now reads the AVR mouse registers (found: X = 0, Y = 1), so the RAM payload moved slightly.
# ATM3/idle blob and file rows updated 2026-10-02 (cdda, PLAN #83): the CdDrive blob (id 39) - the ZX-Evo's IDE slave is a CD drive (CD1=1): its audio state and READ CD staging, ~42 compressed bytes per capture.
# All rows 2026-10-02 (exact-size compression, POC 011 E5): bm4_resident_* down (no unused payload allocation), bm3_journal_writes_opf added; every byte row unchanged.
# Device blob and file rows updated 2026-10-02 (TTD state registry, ttd-engine): the KeyboardMatrix blob (id 46, 56 since 2026-10-04; 22 bytes per capture with its header, no key held) on every machine; nothing else moved.
# Device blob and file rows updated 2026-10-02 (TTD state registry gap 4): the Wd1793Context blob (id 35) on every Beta machine, 52 bytes per capture with its header; nothing else moved.
# Journal and file rows updated 2026-10-03 (D40, journal segments): port OUTs leave the write journal (the port journal has them), and the file gains the journal segment table (20 bytes for one segment).
# All rows 2026-10-04 (ttd-engine landed on master): exported again after the merge - master's device blobs (Profi, Sprinter ISA, ZiFi) and the engine's bm2_work_device_state / bm2_work_scanned_* / bm3_device_regions rows; blob rows move by a few bytes per capture.
# 48K/idle device blob, device state and file rows updated 2026-10-04 (zx-bus-slots, owner decision): the shipped 48K config fits no NeoGS any more - its blob (id 12) leaves every capture; nothing else moved.
# ATM3/idle blob and file rows updated 2026-10-05 (Gluk CMOS /WAIT): the EvoAvrVolatile blob (id 55, now 20 bytes, also on the ATM3); the ERS's CMOS reads wait for the AVR.
# ATM3/idle blob and file rows updated 2026-10-05 (ZX-Evo flash, audit gap G2): the EvoFlash blob (id 61, 33 bytes: the flash chip's command state) on every capture; nothing else moved.
# ATM3/idle device state row updated 2026-10-07 (state-registry gap 15): the EvoPs2 blob (id 19) carries the F12 hold, 56 bytes (was 40); nothing else moved.
# 48K/idle file rows updated 2026-10-08 (idle EAR per board): the 48K's #FE bit 6 follows the EAR output with no tape, the idle ROM's key scans read #BF, and the saved file is 1 byte bigger; nothing else moved.
